player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} shani Indian Poker kawng hta.
- 52-card deck; nahte opponent kawng card chye ju.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) shani round, {max_rounds} round(s) kaba.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X shi positive integer <= nahte chip count.)
- Highest hidden card kawng pot shani showdown hta.

round.announce:
### Hpung {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Na hpang ai hte baw hkau ai lahkam gaw: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Kaw shi ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', amyu '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: N mai [check] - nang gaw shingjawng poi hta shang lawm ai.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet/Raise gumhpraw gaw 1 hta n-ga ra ai.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Hpa mung shaga na n re; nang [check] sha mai ai.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: [bet X] hpe hpaw na matu lang u; sharawt ra ai bet n nga sai.
invalid_move.insufficient: Dai zawn galaw na matu, n-gun atsam grai yawm ai.

board.possible_actions: Nang galaw mai ai lam ni: {legal}

message.showdown_win: Showdown: {card_win} gaw beats {card_lose} hpe dang ai.
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: lahkawng yan {card}. Pot split  langai hpra lu ai gaw {split} re.

outcome.draw: Hkrun lam shagu hta bung ai sumpu ni hpe lang ra ai.
